generated_assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless color-only fabric albedo for an editable Blender material, square 1536 x 1536. Primary request: flat orthographic close scan of antique French-country rust-red and warm ivory cotton-linen ikat curtain cloth. Tile represents 1.25 x 1.25 metres of unfolded cloth. Pattern consists of three varied columns of linked elongated diamonds and broken nested lozenges, with about four diamond lengths vertically. Large warm ivory zigzag ribbons and small ivory diamond centers set in faded terracotta/rust red, irregular handwoven edges, uneven ochre wear patches, intermittent faded rose-red and tawny brown threads. Slight variations between neighboring motifs: irregular narrower/wider arms, broken edges, soft feathered ikat feathering. Match old subtly worn woven dyed cloth, soft muted pigments; no clean vector geometry, no uniform high contrast black lines. Textile completely flat with evenly distributed neutral diffuse lighting; no folds, no drape, no highlights, no shadows, no vignette, no perspective, no frame, no text, no logos. Fine subtle woven thread color texture; do not encode sculpted raised pattern or relief. Opposite image edges must meet seamlessly.
generated_assets.post_processing: None; copied original generated PNG into project. Original generation retained.
generated_assets.role: sRGB pigment into Base Color only
generated_assets.review: Inspected generated output: flat color texture without scene shadows or folds. Texture remains a photo-informed synthesis, not a recovered measured scan. Repetition and reflectance require actual room previews.

generated_assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless color-only albedo scan of one broad face of an old solid roof timber, for a Blender reconstruction. Square image, flat orthographic scan under completely even neutral diffuse illumination, no perspective. A smooth but old French reclaimed pine/oak structural beam face: warm weathered honey brown with pale dry rubbed straw-brown patches, local muted greyish oxidation, a few dark small knots and short black age checks, irregular fine longitudinal growth lines. Fibres run horizontally left to right. Long shallow saw marks and subtle uneven old tool wear, broad areas of relatively plain faded wood interrupted by irregular knots and small old nail stains. Intended physical tile 2.5 metres long by 0.55 metres across. Do not look like deeply cracked tree bark. Do not use dark orange varnish, uniform black crevices, multiple floorboards, seams between boards, shadows, directional highlights, vignettes, text, logos, raised knots or a frame. Surface color only, not a normal/displacement image. Opposite edges join seamlessly.
